import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long x = sc.nextLong();
        long y = sc.nextLong();
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        long a = 0, b = 1;
        double t1 = (double) x / (double) y;
        for (long i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            long l = 1, r = 1000000, ave;
            while (r - l > 1) {
                ave = (l + r) / 2;
                double t2 = (double) ave / (double) i;
                if (t2 < t1) l = ave;
                else r = ave;
            }
            ave = l;
            if (func((int)l, (int)i, (int)x, (int)y) > func((int)r, (int)i, (int)x, (int)y))
                ave = r;
            if (func((int)ave, (int)i, (int)x, (int)y) < func((int)a, (int)b, (int)x, (int)y)) {
                a = ave;
                b = i;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(a + "/" + b);
        sc.close();
    }

    static long gcd(int x, int y) {
        int p = x % y;
        x = y;
        y = p;
        if (y > 0) x = (int) gcd(x, y);
        return x;
    }

    static long lcm(int x, int y) {
        return (long) x * (long) y / gcd(x, y);
    }

    static double func(int x1, int y1, int x2, int y2) {
        long s = lcm(y1, y2);
        long s1 = Math.abs(s / y1 * x1 - s / y2 * x2);
        return (double) s1 / (double) s;
    }
}
